root_cause: Engine shaped every paragraph with one style (layout_with_options took a single TextStyle) and RichText flattened to the first run's style, so later spans lost size, weight, family and line height.
change: crates/incular-text/src/engine.rs (new layout_runs_with_options; shape_paragraph pushes per-run ranged properties via style_properties; shape_raw bypasses the style-keyed shaping pool for styled runs; color_runs); crates/incular-text/src/spans.rs RichText::layout passes all flattened runs; crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs From<RichText> keeps the runs; tree/rendering/lowering/visual.rs resolves each run with the ambient style; tree/layout/behavior/text.rs shapes spans; tree/painting/behavior/content.rs splits glyph runs by span color
harness: text__rich_span_style_metrics: match (was 220x17 vs Flutter 220x36; now matches within the 0.01 px tolerance with the parley default quantization)
api_change: none (RichText API unchanged; StyledTextRun and TextColorRun exported from incular-text)
limitations: Span decorations and per-span shadows are not painted; apply_height_behavior uses the base style's line height only; span colors are painted per glyph run, not per decoration. Glyph color is not checked by the recorder.
note: Measured with quantization on. An unquantized experiment gave 36.30 and was reverted (see text-011).

root_cause: incular-text's WidgetSpan carries only an id and a size; RichText has no child-widget slot, so the span's widget cannot be laid out, positioned or painted, and the engine shapes U+FFFC as a glyph instead of an inline box.
harness: text__widget_span_layout: still diverges (220x19 vs 220x40, no child color).
api_change: Needed: a widget-level WidgetSpan(child) in incular-widgets that RichText lowers to element children, and a placeholder list passed next to the flattened runs to layout_runs_with_options (StyledTextRun is a public struct, so not a new field).
limitations: Remaining work: (1) engine: for each placeholder push a parley InlineBox (push_inline_box) with the measured child size and alignment, and report PositionedLayoutItem::InlineBox rects on TextLayout; (2) widgets: RichText element children for widget spans, laid out loosely first as RenderParagraph._layoutChildren does, sizes fed to the engine, children positioned at the reported rects, painted and hit-tested. Too large for this pass after items 1, 2, 3 and 7; parley 0.12 InlineBox support confirmed.

root_cause: DefaultTextStyle stored only TextStyle; Text had no inherited paragraph policy (maxLines, softWrap, textAlign, overflow).
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/environment.rs (DefaultTextStyle gains paragraph options with text_align, soft_wrap, overflow, max_lines builders; DefaultTextParagraph environment value); tree/descriptors.rs Text fields are Option and inherit when unstated; tree/rendering/lowering/visual.rs resolves inheritance; tree/specs.rs TextParagraphPolicy
harness: text__default_text_style_max_lines: match (harness diagnostic twin now uses DefaultTextStyle.max_lines(1), matching the Flutter twin's maxLines: 1)
api_change: DefaultTextStyle gains text_align, soft_wrap, overflow, max_lines builder methods; Text::align, soft_wrap, overflow, max_lines now store Option semantics (unstated inherits). Text::max_lines(None) now inherits instead of forcing unlimited, matching Flutter null.
limitations: Nested DefaultTextStyle uses the nearest paragraph policy only, not a merge with ancestors (the same nearest-only rule the TextStyle scope already follows). textWidthBasis is not wired to Text.
note: Harness twin edited: harness/incular/tests/frames/text.rs (diagnostic twin, allowed by the brief).

root_cause: parley 0.12 quantization rounds ascent and descent separately (BoxMetrics::from_font), so the baseline moved off the font's exact ascent and fractional line heights summed rounded parts. SkParagraph rounds only the line height, round(descent - ascent + leading) of unrounded metrics (InternalLineMetrics::height), and keeps the baseline unrounded (InternalLineMetrics::baseline).
change: crates/incular-text/src/engine.rs: shape_paragraph builds unquantized (ranged_builder quantize=false); new LineBox/line_boxes/snap_line_boxes stack lines at whole-pixel heights with each baseline at its unrounded distance from its line top; apply_height_behavior now trims the unrounded line boxes before snapping; metrics.line_height is rounded.
harness: text__text_height_behavior_first_ascent: match (was 18.94 vs 19). Before/after runs of text__, layout__, implicit__, transitions__: no new divergences.
api_change: none (metric values change: baselines unrounded, heights still whole pixels)
limitations: Glyph y positions inside a line are unrounded; painting does not snap the baseline to device pixels.
note: Text residual pass. One fix shared with layout-003 and implicit-002. Pixel follow-up: the first version also painted glyphs on the unrounded baseline, which moved text 1 device px at DPR 1.25, 1.5 and 2 (text scenes 2.4-4.3% of pixels over 16). Flutter's raster paints on the line top plus the rounded ascent, so snap_line_boxes now shifts glyphs to top + round(ascent) while TextLine.baseline and metrics.baseline keep the unrounded value. Pixels: text 0.32/0.26/0.17/0.16%, text_dark 0.27/0.19/0.21/0.15%, text_gray 0.05/0.03/0.01/0.02%, text_align 0.18/0.11/0.12/0.16% (audit baseline level); rich_text_spans improved to 0.02% at 1.25x and 2x; no scene worse. Frames unchanged (text__ 24/28, layout__ 35/37, implicit__ 19/19, transitions__ 9/9). Test: height_behavior.rs line_heights_round_while_the_baseline_keeps_the_exact_ascent asserts the paint baseline 12 and reported 11.625.

root_cause: Widget Text had no textScaler; only the lower-level text layer had one.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs Text::text_scaler; tree/specs.rs WidgetKind::Text text_scaler field; tree/rendering/lowering/visual.rs applies style.scaled(scaler) to the base and each span style
harness: text__text_scaler_linear: match (diagnostic twin now uses 14 px with Text::text_scaler(TextScaler::linear(1.5)))
limitations: The system text scale from MediaQuery is not applied, only the explicit scaler.

root_cause: StrutStyle exists as a value type only; Text has no strut builder and the paragraph layout applies no strut.
limitations: Now feasible on top of text-011: apply_height_behavior and snap_line_boxes work on unrounded LineBox values, so a strut is one more pass that widens each line box to at least the strut's ascent and descent (or replaces them with force_strut_height) before snapping. Remaining: API plumbing through WidgetKind::Text (specs.rs, descriptors, lowering, structure equality, LayoutKey) and a Flutter scenario. Deferred for API surface across files outside this group.

root_cause: Same as text-011: the 12 px Inter baseline was the rounded ascent (12, so the row offset was 11) instead of Flutter's 11.625.
change: crates/incular-text/src/engine.rs snap_line_boxes (see text-011). No change in incular-layout.
harness: layout__baseline__cross_axis: match (was 0.625 px off); layout__baseline__without_baseline_child still matches; layout__ 35/37 (the remaining table and box_constraints divergences are unrelated).

root_cause: Same as text-011: at fractional font sizes round(ascent) + round(descent) differs by 1 px from round(ascent + descent).
harness: implicit__default_text_style__text_style: match; transitions__text__default_style: match; implicit__ 19/19, transitions__ 9/9.

root_cause: AnimatedDefaultTextStyle wrapped only the style and dropped the paragraph options.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/implicit_animations.rs (AnimatedDefaultTextStyle gains text_align, soft_wrap, overflow, max_lines; build passes them through DefaultTextStyle::with_paragraph); crates/incular-widgets/src/environment.rs (with_paragraph helper)
harness: no scenario for the paragraph options; implicit__default_text_style__text_style residual unchanged (see implicit-002)
api_change: AnimatedDefaultTextStyle gains text_align, soft_wrap, overflow, max_lines builder methods
limitations: textWidthBasis and a textHeightBehavior on the default style are not wired (the separate DefaultTextHeightBehavior still applies).
